Payments

Provider-neutral contracts for customers, payment methods, charges, payouts and webhooks, with typed clients for Stripe and the Omie ERP.

Packages

Package What it does Builds on
Payment Provider-neutral payment abstractions: contracts for customers and saved payment methods, payee accounts and their onboarding, charges and transfers, and webhook verification, with minor-unit arithmetic and the shared resilient HttpClient registration the NuvTools.Payment provider clients build on. Common
Payment.Omie.ApiClient Typed HTTP client for the Omie ERP API. Common
Payment.Stripe.ApiClient Typed client for Stripe, covering customers and saved payment methods, Connect Express onboarding, separate charges and transfers, and webhook signature verification. Common, Payment
